init_wandb_singleton: initialize the WandBSingletonLogger with config, run_id, project, entity, and log_dir parameters
log_with_wandb_singleton: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the WandBSingletonLogger get_instance method
log_table_wandb: log a wandb Table with column names and row data using the WandBSingletonLogger log_table method
watch_model_gradients: watch a pytorch model parameters and gradients with wandb using the WandBLogger watch method
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics like mean std min max to wandb using the log_stats convenience function
